name: How do I choose the right contractor for a foreclosed property overhaul?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a foreclosed property overhaul?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for an owner-operated or dedicated general contractor who specializes in structural finish work and has verified local credentials, like an A+ BBB rating. Foreclosure repairs require diverse capabilities under one roof, from custom framing and drywall replacement to tile setting and finish carpentry. You need an on-site lead who actively inspects work rather than passing you between sales reps. Ask how they handle coordination with licensed specialty trades for electrical and plumbing, and ensure they provide clear, itemized scopes of work that distinguish must-do repairs from aesthetic finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an accredited, hands-on contractor who combines framing, drywall, and finish carpentry skills with clear management of licensed electrical and plumbing trades.
